posts.en:
dsh-llm-github-copilot is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-25a667a576424d10d281.html
